reason: Holding out a monotone rank group also holds out its non-monotone suit cousins. The requested monotone-family verdict must explicitly inspect the monotone subgroup, not just the combined rank-group score.
rule: Report both the complete monotone rank-group holdout and its unpaired:monotone subgroup. Apply the original thresholds and baseline comparisons to both, and downgrade overall use if either fails. No fitting, split, threshold, or hyperparameter changes.
paired_family: All suit cousins of a paired rank triple are paired, so the paired grouped holdout is already a paired-only family test.
